Why decide before the programme starts?

These policies set the programme's boundaries before teams begin. Today, the choice is often presented as all eight or none, even though each policy has its own default and can be selected separately.

The policy list today lives in a file, and the choice has been all eight or none. Policy 2 determines whether the board code shrinks by 25% or 10%. Policies 3 and 6 target repeat permission asks. Policy 3 creates access until revoked; policy 5 permits permanent deletion. They deserve particular care.

Your two paths

Recommended

Apply the policies you select

The selected settings are recorded and handed to their teams. Unselected settings stay at their defaults. Take care with 3 (no expiry) and 5 (permanent deletion).

Keep all defaults

None of the eight settings changes. The teams proceed within today's limits, including a separate grant each time and no automatic permanent run deletion.

If you do not answer: all eight safe defaults remain in force, and the programme does not wait for your reply.

Second opinion: policies 3 and 5 are harder to take back and deserve their own answer; the other six are easy to reverse.
